description: List all tags associated with a specific Zendesk organization. Use when you need to retrieve the tags assigned to a particular organization for ticket categorization, filtering, or reporting purposes.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing organization tags.

organization_id.description: The numeric ID of the organization whose tags to retrieve. Must be a non-null integer; cast to int if sourced from tools that return it as a string. Do not pass null (skip the call if organization_id is null). Obtain from zendesk.get_all_zendesk_organizations or zendesk.get_zendesk_organization.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

inputSchema.title: GetOrganizationTagsRequest

name: get_organization_tags

GetOrganizationTagsResponse.description: Response containing tags for a specific organization.

tags.description: An array of tag names associated with the organization.
tags.title: Tags

GetOrganizationTagsResponse.title: GetOrganizationTagsResponse
